nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: Application entry point that boots the full SARAS stack: configures logging, starts HelixDB, initializes MessageOrchestrator, and launches all service connectors (Telegram, Discord, Slack, Web, WhatsApp, Voice, MQTT, Webhook, Streamlit) as concurrent async tasks with graceful shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.run() to drive the async main loop; signal handlers for SIGINT/SIGTERM; subprocess management for HelixDB sidecar and Streamlit dashboard.

nodes.name: orchestrator.py
nodes.summary: Central message router (MessageOrchestrator) that receives requests from any platform, registers all tools and agents into AgentRuntime and SwarmManager, handles direct slash commands (/git, /file, /web, /virus, /goal, /tasks, /kg, /scene, /cron, /skills, /learned, /internet), routes System 1 fast-paths, and escalates complex queries to System 2 via AgentRuntime.execute_turn().
nodes.languageNotes: Registers 60+ tools dynamically; implements direct-command handlers for git, file, web, virus, image, goal, kg, scene, cron, skills, internet; uses System1Router for fast-path responses.

nodes.name: runtime.py
nodes.summary: AgentRuntime — the embedded execution environment for agent turns. Implements the ReAct loop (up to 15 turns) with tool execution, policy enforcement, privacy checks, multi-provider fallback, session management, memory extraction, metacognitive monitoring, persona updates, and observability tracing. Manages cost routing, verification, vault, audit, and conversation compression.
nodes.languageNotes: Full ReAct loop with tool-call streak detection, synthesis nudges, streaming support; v2 feature flags for cost router, verifier, vault, audit, policy, privacy, conversation.

nodes.name: agency.py
nodes.summary: Agent swarm manager (SwarmManager) and worker (WorkerAgent). SwarmManager coordinates parallel execution of specialized sub-agents (FinanceAgent, ResearcherAgent, SecurityAgent, etc.) via asyncio.gather, compiles evidence boards, and passes results to ReviewerQA for synthesis. WorkerAgent wraps BaseAgent with its own AgentRuntime for autonomous task execution.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.gather for parallel sub-agent execution; WorkerAgent wraps AgentRuntime with a custom system prompt from BaseAgent.get_enhanced_prompt().

nodes.name: kernel.py
nodes.summary: SystemKernel — central capability registry and graph for SARAS. Tools, agents, and sensors register here to declare intent, cost, risk level, and permissions. Maintains a live capability graph used by the PolicyEngine for deny-by-default routing decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: ModuleManifest dataclass for metadata; SystemKernel maintains Dict[str, ModuleManifest] and a capability graph with tools/agents/sensors buckets.

nodes.name: skill_registry.py
nodes.summary: SkillRegistry discovers skill/plugin manifests from the repository tree (module.yaml, manifest.json, SKILL.md), normalizes records with health reports, supports query-based skill matching via token-overlap scoring, loads plugin tools dynamically, and renders active skill texts for system prompt injection.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-format manifest parsing (YAML, JSON, SKILL.md frontmatter); health scoring with semantic version validation; plugin dynamic import via importlib.util.

nodes.name: skill_v2/registry.py
nodes.summary: SkillRegistryV2 — CRUD layer over the skill directory root with enabled/disabled/quarantined state. Supports validation, eval-based promotion (auto-enable on N successful evals), quarantine on failure, trust-signing enforcement, and community browsing. Persists state to a JSON file.
nodes.languageNotes: Stateful registry backed by SkillLayoutRoot; RegistryState dataclass with enabled/disabled/quarantined sets; eval-based promotion gate.

nodes.name: skill_v2/manifest.py
nodes.summary: Skill manifest dataclasses and validation. Defines the full skill contract: identity, provenance (source, trust), capabilities (permissions, risk_level, inputs, outputs), promotion threshold, eval records, and tags. Includes pure validation (semver, permissions, identifier format) and JSON serialization helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Enums: RiskLevel, ManifestSource, ManifestTrust, Permission; dataclasses: InputSchema, OutputSchema, EvalRecord, SkillManifest; semver regex validation.

nodes.name: conversation/manager.py
nodes.summary: ConversationManager — runtime-facing wrapper around WorkingMemory, Compressor, and FollowUpResolver. Maps session_id to WorkingMemory, manages ingest/context/resolve operations, handles compression when deque grows past threshold, and supports persistence via serialize/restore.
nodes.languageNotes: Thread-safe with RLock; configurable window_size and compress_threshold_multiplier; swappable summary function (deterministic or LLM-backed).

nodes.name: conversation/memory.py
nodes.summary: WorkingMemory for multi-turn conversations — per-session state with summary, recent_turns deque, facts dict, entities Counter, and current_topic. Includes deterministic fact extraction (key=value regex), entity extraction (capitalized phrases), and topic detection (explicit hints, entities, first sentence).
nodes.languageNotes: dataclass with slots; deque(maxlen=20) for recent turns; regex-based extractors (_KEY_VALUE_PATTERN, _MULTI_CAP, _SINGLE_CAP); comprehensive English stopword set.

nodes.name: memory_manager.py
nodes.summary: MemoryManager — extracts and stores long-term memory from conversation turns. Categorizes extractions into facts, preferences, tasks, and tool guides; stores via MemoryStore; supports pruning (stale entries), conflict merging, governance summaries, and profile building from retrieved memories.
nodes.languageNotes: Dataclasses: MemoryExtract, MemoryGovernanceRule; sentence-level heuristic extraction with phrase matching; memory pruning by age.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: Persistent semantic memory store with three backends: ChromaDB (default), PostgreSQL+pgvector, and HelixDB. MemoryStore uses SentenceTransformer embeddings for semantic search; PgvectorMemoryStore uses cosine similarity; factory function selects backend based on MEMORY_BACKEND config.
nodes.languageNotes: Three backend implementations behind a factory function; all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model; content-addressed dedup via SHA-256; lazy singleton pattern.

nodes.name: policy.py
nodes.summary: PolicyEngine v1 — the security gate between runtime and tool calls. Evaluates tool capabilities against user/agent permissions, checks risk levels and confirmation policies, and enforces deny-by-default using the SystemKernel capability graph. Persists policy rules to a JSON file.
nodes.languageNotes: PolicyDecision dataclass; requires_approval() checks policy JSON for pattern matching (contains, match, not_none, in); evaluate() checks capability permissions.

nodes.name: policy_v2/engine.py
nodes.summary: PolicyEngine v2 — risk-score-based policy gate with trust-tier damping. Computes raw risk from action table + per-arg factors, applies trust-tier multipliers (admin=0, trusted=0.7, untrusted=1.3), compares against ask/deny thresholds, enqueues ApprovalRequest for ASK verdicts, and records audit events.
nodes.languageNotes: ThresholdConfig with ask/deny thresholds and tier_damping; evaluate() pipeline: hard deny/allow → raw risk → trust damping → verdict → approval queue → audit.

nodes.name: bootstrapper.py
nodes.summary: Bootstrapper — builds dynamic system prompts by reading SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, and standing_orders.md from the workspace, injecting memory context, user profile, workspace graph evidence, active skills, and temporal context (time of day). Creates default template files if missing.
nodes.languageNotes: File-Injected Context Strategy; _read_and_truncate for bounded file reads; build_dynamic_context() for temporal awareness; build_system_prompt() assembles all sections.

nodes.name: persona.py
nodes.summary: Dynamic Personality Engine (PersonaEngine) managing emotional state, user relationships, personality drift, learned values, and relationship milestones. Generates personality-influenced system prompts with tone/verbosity/energy/humor calibration. Tracks per-user formality progression and interaction milestones.
nodes.languageNotes: Dataclasses: EmotionalState, UserRelationship, PersonalityDrift, LearnedValue, RelationshipMilestone; JSON persistence per user; greeting templates keyed by (mood, formality).

nodes.name: soul_engine.py
nodes.summary: Soul Engine — AetherRavyn's identity core. Loads and parses SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md from project root; merges with PersonaEngine to produce a unified, dynamic system prompt reflecting evolving personality, user knowledge, and workspace context. Supports platform-specific adaptations and circadian rhythms.
nodes.languageNotes: SoulProfile, MemoryProfile, WorkspaceInstructions dataclasses; YAML frontmatter parsing; cached loading with 60s TTL; voice context integration.

nodes.name: events.py
nodes.summary: Unified event envelope (Envelope) for cross-boundary communication. Signed with ed25519, schema-versioned, size-bounded (≤8KB), with content-addressed body support. Defines EventKind categories (chat, tool_call, alert, audit, etc.), Header metadata, and TrustStore for signer verification.
nodes.languageNotes: Dataclasses: Header, Envelope, TrustedSigner, TrustStore; ed25519 signing with HMAC fallback; canonical JSON payload for deterministic signing.

nodes.name: hooks.py
nodes.summary: Event-driven hook system (HookDispatcher) for lifecycle and tool events. Supports async and sync handlers; dispatches events by name to registered handlers with error isolation. Used by runtime for turn_completed events and other lifecycle callbacks.
nodes.languageNotes: HookHandler type alias (async or sync callable); dispatch() awaits coroutines; error isolation per handler.

nodes.name: session.py
nodes.summary: SessionManager — persistent session state via JSONL files. Provides load/append/prune/summarize operations; prunes to a sliding window of N messages (preserving system prompt); summarizes older turns into a compact system message.
nodes.languageNotes: JSONL file-based persistence; summarize_session() collapses old turns into a single system message.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Core data models: ReplyTarget (platform + chat_id), IncomingRequest (platform + user + text + target), ToolTrace (tool execution record), SignalPayload (multi-format output with text, files, audio, traces).
nodes.languageNotes: All dataclasses with slots=True; IncomingRequest supports image_urls and voice_reply; SignalPayload carries tool_traces and evidence.

nodes.name: health.py
nodes.summary: Dependency Health Monitor — periodically checks external services (Redis, Ollama, Home Assistant, SMTP, Google Calendar) and reports status. Supports graceful degradation: UNKNOWN for unconfigured services, DOWN for failures, HEALTHY/DEGRADED for latency-based checks.
nodes.languageNotes: ServiceNotConfigured exception for unconfigured services; ServiceStatus enum; async check_all() with concurrent execution; latency-based health/degraded classification.

nodes.name: cli/main.py
nodes.summary: CLI entry point with subcommands: daemon (FastAPI + background loops), chat (terminal chat), status (edge nodes + pending approvals), approve (task approval), edge-node (edge device runner), helix (HelixDB sidecar), kg (knowledge graph).
nodes.languageNotes: argparse with subparsers; cmd_daemon runs _main_async in a background thread; cmd_chat creates a local MessageOrchestrator.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Central configuration class (Config) with all environment variable definitions. Covers LLM providers, platform tokens (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp), API keys, voice pipeline, home automation, memory backends, privacy, citations, modular platform, MQTT, and dashboard settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Class-level attributes (no __init__); all values read from os.getenv with sensible defaults; dotenv support via try/except ImportError.

nodes.name: base.py

nodes.languageNotes: Python 3.12+, uses abc.ABC, dataclasses, type hints

nodes.name: ToolParameter

nodes.name: ToolCapability

nodes.name: BaseTool

nodes.languageNotes: Python, uses asyncio.to_thread for sync HTTP calls, in-process dict cache

nodes.name: WebOperationTool

nodes.name: _search_gemini

nodes.name: _search_grok

nodes.name: _detect_provider
nodes.summary: Auto-detects search provider by checking env vars in order: Brave → Gemini → Perplexity → Grok.

nodes.name: webfetch.py

nodes.languageNotes: Python, optional dependencies: requests, bs4, google-genai/google-generativeai

nodes.name: AdvancedFileOperationTool

nodes.languageNotes: JSON-based persistence with Path operations. Properties with getters/setters.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: OpenAIProviderClient — concrete BaseLLMProvider for OpenAI-compatible APIs. Supports configurable base_url, optional request_fn for testing, and async HTTP via requests.post in a thread. Parses OpenAI chat completion responses and extracts content from choices.
nodes.languageNotes: Async wrapper around sync requests.post via asyncio.to_thread. Graceful handling of missing requests package.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: AnthropicProviderClient — concrete BaseLLMProvider for Anthropic's Messages API. Converts OpenAI-style messages to Anthropic format (system prompt extraction, role mapping), sends to /messages endpoint, and extracts text from content blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Static method _to_anthropic_messages handles message format conversion between OpenAI and Anthropic schemas.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: GoogleProviderClient — concrete BaseLLMProvider for Google Gemini/Generative Language API. Converts messages to Google's contents format (role mapping: system→user, assistant→model), uses API key auth via URL query parameter, and extracts text from candidates.
nodes.languageNotes: Google API uses key in URL rather than header. Generation config is a nested object.

nodes.name: clinet.py
nodes.summary: XAIGrpcClient — gRPC-based client for xAI's Chat API. Unlike other providers (HTTP), this uses Protocol Buffers and gRPC stubs. Supports chat completion, streaming, and image input. Handles proto module imports from multiple possible locations.
nodes.languageNotes: gRPC client with lazy proto module imports. Non-async (blocking gRPC calls). Multi-module import resolution for generated stubs.

nodes.name: model_router.py
nodes.summary: Contains two routing classes: ModelRouter (classifies text into local/cheap/deep routes, prefers local Ollama for simple queries, uses FeedbackStore for route bias) and AutoModelRouter (static class that auto-detects the best available provider by checking local endpoints, API keys, CLI tools, and free fallbacks in priority order).
nodes.languageNotes: RouteDecision dataclass with slots=True. AutoModelRouter uses classmethods exclusively. Local endpoint health checks via urllib.

nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: CostRouter — a sophisticated model routing engine that selects the cheapest model satisfying quality, cost, capability, and budget constraints. Features: source-trust capping (low-trust sources can't use expensive models), per-request and remaining budget enforcement, quality-scored candidate ranking (cost + latency - quality*0.10), fallback chain generation, and health-aware filtering.
nodes.languageNotes: Module docstring documents design philosophy. Score formula: cost + latency/1000 - quality*0.10. Budget uses min(per-request, remaining, ledger-config).

nodes.name: pipeline.py
nodes.summary: VoicePipeline — a blocking microphone-to-LLM-to-speaker pipeline implementing the always-on voice interface. Uses openwakeword (ONNX) for wake word detection, RMS-based VAD for speech endpointing, faster-whisper/pywhispercpp for STT, and piper TTS for synthesis. Features: barge-in detection, speaker identification, audio feedback chimes, sentence-level streaming TTS, and sink registry for multi-output fan-out (local speaker + browser WebSocket).
nodes.languageNotes: Runs blocking audio loop in thread executor. Uses asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe for thread→async bridging. Lazy heavy imports (numpy, sounddevice, openwakeword).

nodes.name: tts.py
nodes.summary: TTS engine using Piper-TTS (local ONNX) for the AetherRavyn personality. Provides synthesize() returning WAV file path and synthesize_bytes() for browser-WS sink. Handles backward-compat with legacy edge-tts BCP-47 voice names via deprecation warnings. Voice resolution: explicit path → Config.PIPER_VOICE_MODEL → legacy Config.VOICE_TTS_VOICE → default model.
nodes.languageNotes: Async functions wrapping sync Piper calls. DeprecatedConfig pattern with warnings.warn. File-path-based API for backward compat.

nodes.name: transcribe.py
nodes.summary: Async audio-to-text transcription with two engines: whisper.cpp via pywhispercpp (CPU, ggml quantized, ~75MB) as primary, Vosk small English model as offline fallback. Thread-safe model caching, configurable via WHISPER_CPP_MODEL/LANGUAGE/THREADS env vars. Supports WHISPER_CPP_OFFLINE=1 for test environments. Input normalization to WAV mono 16kHz 16-bit.
nodes.languageNotes: Global model cache with threading.Lock. pywhispercpp wraps C++ whisper.cpp. Audio format conversion via pydub for Vosk fallback.

nodes.name: speaker_id.py
nodes.summary: Speaker identification via voice embeddings. Supports two backends: resemblyzer (lightweight) and speechbrain (ECAPA-TDNN, higher accuracy). Features: enrollment (average multiple samples for better accuracy), cosine similarity matching (0.75 threshold), persistence to workspace/voice/speaker_profiles/ as JSON + .npy files. Returns (user_id, confidence) tuples.
nodes.languageNotes: Module singleton pattern via get_speaker_identifier(). Lazy encoder loading. Embedding persistence via numpy .save/.load.

nodes.name: voicetool.py
nodes.summary: VoiceTool — agent tool implementing voice I/O operations: detect_wake_word (OpenWakeWord), listen (sounddevice recording), transcribe (Vosk), speak (Edge TTS), and voice_pipeline (full wake→record→transcribe sequence). Extends BaseTool with a rich ToolSchema. Publishes events to VoiceEventBus for each stage.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends BaseTool. Event bus integration via optional import. Multiple optional dependency guards (sounddevice, vosk, edge_tts, openwakeword).

nodes.name: camera_bridge.py
nodes.summary: HTTP webhook receiver bridge between the monitoring/ anomaly detection system and SARAS BotSignal. Handles POST /internal/camera-alert events (person_detected, etc.) and notifies admin users via their configured messaging platforms with optional snapshot attachments.
nodes.languageNotes: Async handler function. Uses Config.ADMIN_USER_IDS for notification targets. Parses platform:chat_id format.

nodes.name: mqtt_listener.py
nodes.summary: Async MQTT subscriber that monitors IoT sensor topics, stores latest readings in-memory (_sensor_state dict), and fires BotSignal alerts for anomalous conditions (motion detection, temperature extremes >35°C or <5°C). Auto-reconnects on connection drops with 10-second backoff.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses aiomqtt async client. Module-level state dict (_sensor_state). Async reconnect loop with backoff.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: ProactiveEngine — four-stage pipeline that decides SPEAK/SILENCE/DEFER for incoming ProactiveSignals: (1) DND/quiet hours check, (2) value gate scoring (value × confidence - interruption_cost), (3) silence/rate-limit/dedup/annoyance, (4) channel dispatch. Per-user, pluggable stages, stateless decision producer (never sends directly).
nodes.languageNotes: Dataclass configs with factory defaults. EngineConfig composes GateConfig, SilenceConfig, DispatcherConfig. for_user() classmethod for per-user instantiation.

nodes.name: anticipation.py
nodes.summary: Anticipation engine that predicts user needs from learned habits. Supports three pattern types: time-of-day (rolling average trigger time), day-of-week, and sequence (X then Y). HabitTracker records fire events with rolling average updates. AnticipationEngine generates Predictions with confidence scores. generate_signals() builder combines follow-ups, anomalies, and predictions into deduplicated ProactiveSignals.
nodes.languageNotes: Protocol-based HabitStore for pluggable storage. Rolling average formula for trigger time. Confidence asymptotes at 0.95 with 10 occurrences.

nodes.name: dispatcher.py
nodes.summary: ChannelDispatcher picks (channel, target) for a ProactiveSignal using per-kind ChannelPreference table, urgency overrides (CRITICAL→voice), and per-user channel registration. Falls back to default_channel. Returns SPEAK decision with or without a resolved target — the delivery adapter fills in missing targets via continuity resolver.
nodes.languageNotes: DispatcherConfig dataclass with urgency overrides. Two-level fallback: preferred channel → default channel. Target=None triggers adapter-level resolution.

nodes.name: autonomy_engine.py
nodes.summary: AutonomyEngine — background engine for long-horizon autonomous planning and execution. Manages a goals.jsonl file with a step state machine (Pending→InProgress→Completed, Retry with exponential backoff up to 3 retries, Blocked). Each cycle: plans via TaskPlanner, executes steps via AgentRuntime, verifies via ResultVerifier, notifies via TaskInboxStore. Blocked steps don't block independent siblings.
nodes.languageNotes: JSONL file format for goal persistence. Atomic file writes via tmp+replace pattern. ConductorAgent for project management delegation.

nodes.name: cognition_ladder.py
nodes.summary: CognitionLadder — 4-step model escalation that starts with tiny/cheap models and escalates only when confidence is too low. Default ladder: tiny (ollama/qwen2.5:3b, 0.65 floor) → small (groq/llama-3.1-8b, 0.70) → medium (anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5, 0.80) → large (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5, accept all). Cache-aware, failure-aware (skips failed steps on retry), per-step timeouts.
nodes.languageNotes: Producer type alias: Callable[[LadderStep], Awaitable[tuple[str, float]]]. Cache key includes model+prompt+suffix. LadderResult.to_dict() for serialization.

nodes.name: metacognition.py
nodes.summary: MetaCognitiveMonitor — tracks reasoning quality across problem categories and adapts strategy selection. Records PerformanceRecords (query category, strategy, tools, success, confidence, duration). Uses Thompson sampling-inspired exploration/exploitation for strategy selection (analytical, creative, systematic, rapid, collaborative). Persists aggregated StrategyStats to metacog.json.
nodes.languageNotes: Score formula: success_rate*0.5 + avg_confidence*0.3 + speed_bonus*0.2. Exploration bonus: 1/sqrt(attempts)*0.1. Global singleton via get_metacognitive_monitor().

nodes.name: perception.py
nodes.summary: PerceptionEngine — background internet monitoring that watches user-defined topics via AgentReach (multi-source discovery: DuckDuckGo, Reddit, YouTube). Extracts evidence items with sentiment analysis (keyword heuristics), stores to evidence.jsonl, and feeds into the world knowledge graph. Topics persist to watched_topics.json with configurable check intervals.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic models for WatchedTopic and EvidenceItem. AgentReach for multi-source web discovery. Simple keyword-based sentiment analysis.

nodes.name: attention.py
nodes.summary: WorkingMemory — bounded 7±2 item attention buffer mimicking human cognitive constraints. Items have relevance (decays over time), importance (eviction resistance), and access patterns. Features: focus/dismiss/get operations, relevance decay with periodic apply_decay(), priority-based eviction (effective_score = relevance*0.4 + importance*0.3 + recency*0.3), and context text generation for prompt injection.
nodes.languageNotes: Miller's Law (7±2) capacity. Effective score combines relevance, importance, and recency. Capacity clamped to 3-12 range.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Default routine registration on the v2 scheduler. Aggregates morning briefing, evening review, weekly digest, anomaly digest, calendar watcher, internet watcher, and autonomy worker into a single register_default_routines call.

nodes.name: register_default_routines
nodes.summary: Registers every built-in routine (morning, evening, weekly, anomaly) for one user on the v2 scheduler.

nodes.name: register_default_signals
nodes.summary: Registers watcher routines (calendar, internet, autonomy) on IntervalTrigger schedules with signal router.

nodes.name: orchestrator.py
nodes.summary: PrivacyManager facade tying detection, redaction, consent, and retention. Provides redact_text, check_consent, schedule_retention, purge_due, delete_user, and async persistence mirror for HelixDB. Thread-safe with in-memory defaults.

nodes.name: PrivacyManager
nodes.summary: Process-level facade for privacy package: detection, redaction, consent, and retention with async HelixDB persistence mirror.

nodes.name: PrivacyConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration dataclass for privacy manager with default policies, IP detection flag, and retention policy.

nodes.name: PrivacyError
nodes.summary: PermissionError subclass raised when privacy/consent check refuses an operation.

nodes.name: citations.py
nodes.summary: Trust & Explainability: Citations system. Data model for traceable facts with CitationSource (MEMORY/FILE/WEB/TOOL/GRAPH/USER/INFERENCE), Citation, CitedFact, and CitationManager. Renderer inserts [1]/[2] markers and appends sources list. Thread-safe with deduplication.

nodes.name: CitationManager
nodes.summary: Process-level facade for citations with registration, rendering, and lookup. Thread-safe with deduplication.

nodes.name: Citation
nodes.summary: Immutable dataclass for a single source backing a fact with source kind, reference, title, and snippet.

nodes.name: CitationSource
nodes.summary: Enum of citation source kinds: MEMORY, FILE, WEB, TOOL, GRAPH, USER, INFERENCE.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing AetherRavyn tools over stdio JSON-RPC transport. Implements initialize, tools/list, and tools/call handlers. Wraps BaseTool instances as MCP-compatible tool descriptors with JSON Schema input formats.

nodes.name: MCPServer
nodes.summary: MCP server exposing AetherRavyn tools over stdio JSON-RPC with initialize/tools/list/tools/call handlers.

nodes.name: MCPToolDescriptor
nodes.summary: MCP-compatible tool descriptor with name, description, and input_schema.

nodes.name: manager.py
nodes.summary: MCP dynamic tool discovery — loads tools from configured MCP servers via stdio transport. MCPManager connects to multiple servers concurrently, discovers their tools, and wraps each in MCPToolAdapter (BaseTool) for AgentRuntime registration.

nodes.name: MCPManager
nodes.summary: Connects to multiple MCP servers concurrently and exposes their tools as BaseTool adapters.

nodes.name: MCPToolAdapter
nodes.summary: Wraps an MCP tool as a BaseTool for AgentRuntime integration.
